entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your name and order number?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Ride cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered about 18 days ago. What specifically is the issue with them?
They're just not good. The cycling shoes gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I've tried moving the cleats around, but nothing helps. I just want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear they're causing you blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you... Yes, I can see that the item is well within our 90-day return window.

I've gone ahead and initiated that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, we'll process your full refund.
Whatever. As long as I get the money back.
Absolutely. You should see the refund reflected in your account within 3 to 5 business days after we receive the return. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
